Immediate technical assistance.

12.

a. The Bank Group is helping the Government to complete a comprehensive

structural damage assessment focused on housing, schools, health facilities,

residential structures and small businesses. Experiences in post-disaster

response and recovery (e.g. Haiti 2010, Kashmir 2005, Gujarat 2001) underline

the critical importance of building-level damage surveys. A single

comprehensive structural and household status assessment would be an

powerful tool to ensure public safety (against the risk of compromised

buildings), assist with the social and economic recovery (by encouraging the

reoccupation of safe buildings), relieve trauma (by demonstrating the recovery
